notes.title: NEDRA – Update v1.0.5
notes.notes:
This update focuses on improving gameplay balance, fixing bugs, and addressing community feedback. As a solo developer, I truly appreciate all the support and detailed reports you've shared.

What's new in v1.0.5:

Minor bug fixes and stability improvements

Adjusted combat for better balance

Increased time before hypothermia begins

Fixed several audio issues

Fixed collision issues in various areas

Reduced intensity of the alcohol screen effect

Enlarged the warning text in the main menu about potentially uncomfortable visual/audio elements

Other small fixes and improvements

Thanks again to everyone who’s played and provided feedback. I’ll continue working to improve the game with future updates.

notes.title: PAX East 2025 Update
notes.notes:
Some exciting news for PAX East 2025!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320266/6fc40543ac5df11ec1fe63974ddddc1ee4059d77.png

From May 8–11, the indie.io team will be showcasing an exclusive hands-on demo of NEDRA at the event in Boston, Massachusetts.

This special demo will only be available to attendees during the show, and I’m really looking forward to hearing what players think. Getting real-time feedback is a huge step in shaping the future of the game.

Will any of you be in Boston? Let us know—we’d love to hear from you!

notes.title: Dev Update #2: Do you have a minute?
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320266/2aa06603e4f263f986aed6f60a2017571a364734.png

It's been an exciting journey developing NEDRA and now that I'm approaching a key milestone, I want to open up the conversation with all of you—the players who love survival horror as much as I do.

By now, you know that NEDRA takes place in the frozen isolation of a Soviet Antarctic station. It's a game of survival, where managing body temperature is as crucial as avoiding the horrors lurking in the cold. You'll need to make strategic choices—whether to engage threats head-on or slip past unnoticed. Every decision matters, and every resource is scarce.

As I get closer to releasing more updates and preparing for NEDRA's Next Fest debut, I’d love to hear your thoughts:


 What about NEDRA excites you the most?

 What gameplay elements are you most looking forward to?
 
 What aspects of survival horror games do you love (or dislike) the most?


I’m also curious about how you like to engage with games and their development:


 Do you enjoy behind-the-scenes content from game development?
 
 What do you want to learn about NEDRA’s creation process?
 
 What’s your favorite platform to connect with fellow horror fans?


While I can’t promise every piece of feedback will make it into the game, knowing what excites and intrigues you helps shape the experience.

With your support, I'll make NEDRA the best it can be.

Davit
